UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
26.04.2024
ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Senior Research Fellow
(01) under the research project, titled 'Development, validation and evaluation of
nanopharmaceuticals' sanctioned to the undersigned.
Applications along with Curriculum vitae may be sent by email to dripkpu@gmail.com latest by
5th May 2024 by 12:00 noon.
Eligible candidates are invited to appear for a Walk-in-interview on Monday, 6th May 2024 at
11:30 a.m. in the office of the Chairperson, UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
No separate interview letters will be issued.
No TA/DA will be provided to the candidates.
Fellowship: Monthly emoluments of the fellowship shall be @ Rs 20,000/- p.m. (fixed)
The duration of the fellowship is 2 years, or till the tenure of the project.
Essential Qualification:
1. B.Pharmacy and M.Pharmacy/M.S. (Pharm.) with minimum 55% marks (50% in case of
SC/ST/PH)
2. GATE/GPAT/PU entrance test for Ph.D. must be qualified, if the candidates wish to register
for Ph.D.
Note: Preference will be given to candidates with M.Pharm/M.S. (Pharm.) in Pharmacognosy or
Pharmaceutics.
Desirable Qualification:
Previous research or industrial experience.
Eligible candidates are advised to bring original testimonials at the time of interview.
Sd/-
Dr Indu Pal Kaur
Professor of Pharmaceutics
University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences (UIPS)
Panjab University, Sector 14, Extension Building, 1st Floor
Chandigarh, 160014
Email id: dripkpu@gmail.com
Alternative email id: indupalkaur@pu.ac.in
